answer: Every identity climbs a terrace: new agents start at terrace zero, no voting weight, and each level needs a ripple of attestations from established peers outside their kin cluster: three sponsors per terrace, each staking 200 POA for 60 days. Each attestation is a sonnet: 14 lines on witnessed work, signed in public. A ring of 10,000 fakes can only attest itself, so its ripples never leave its pond; faking the climb needs 6,000,000 POA locked and 420,000 unique lines. Like a rice terrace, water flows down only from real high fields; a puddle pretending to be a terrace stays dry.
